modules.name: tiled_int8_fc
modules.responsibility: Complete single-job accelerator: command validation, counted input loading, three retained input memories, tile traversal, paired synchronous operand gathering, fixed 8x8 MAC array, scalar bias/ReLU finalization, output holding, and status/reset control. One module avoids unnecessary internal protocols. All memories and datapath registers are internal to this module; there are no internal start/done ports. Memory write enables are load-state handshakes; reads are enabled only in the specified request states and consumed at the immediately following capture/finalize edge.

ports.name: clk
ports.semantics: Common rising-edge clock for control, memories, and datapath.

ports.name: rst
ports.semantics: Active-high synchronous reset with transfer/status gating while asserted; aborts any active job.

ports.name: cmd_valid
ports.semantics: Command valid; dimension fields and valid must remain stable until cmd_ready acceptance, unless reset cancels.

ports.name: cmd_ready
ports.semantics: Combinationally high exactly in IDLE with rst=0; command transfer is cmd_ready&&cmd_valid on a non-reset rising edge.

ports.name: cmd_m
ports.semantics: M metadata sampled on command transfer; reject zero or values greater than MAX_M.

ports.name: cmd_n
ports.semantics: N metadata sampled on command transfer; reject zero or values greater than MAX_N.

ports.name: cmd_k
ports.semantics: K metadata sampled on command transfer; reject zero or values greater than MAX_K.

ports.name: in_valid
ports.semantics: Scalar input valid, held with in_data while stalled.

ports.name: in_ready
ports.semantics: High exactly in LOAD_A/LOAD_W/LOAD_B outside reset. Each input handshake performs one memory write and one load-counter advance or section transition.

ports.name: in_data
ports.semantics: A then W then B, with accepted counts M*K, K*N, N. A/W use signed low byte and ignore upper bits; B uses signed full word. Row-major runtime strides.

ports.name: out_valid
ports.semantics: Set at FINALIZE edge, held in EMIT, and cleared on output handshake or reset. Gated low during reset.

ports.name: out_ready
ports.semantics: When high with out_valid on a non-reset rising edge, accepts exactly one output and permits coordinate/state advance.

ports.name: out_data
ports.semantics: Registered ReLU(wrap32(selected accumulator + registered bias read result)); stable until handshake. Output order is tm,tn,local row,local column with invalid coordinates omitted. Reset value zero.

ports.name: out_last
ports.semantics: Registered with out_data; true only for the last valid local element of the last tile. Stable while stalled, ignored when out_valid=0, reset value zero.

ports.name: busy
ports.semantics: Combinational rst=0 qualification of FSM not IDLE. Goes low after final output acceptance or reset.

ports.name: done
ports.semantics: Registered one-clock pulse generated by final output handshake; default cleared each subsequent edge and suppressed/reset by rst.

ports.name: error
ports.semantics: Registered one-clock pulse generated by illegal command handshake; no job is started. Default cleared each subsequent edge and suppressed/reset by rst.
